Roles and permissions

Assigned caseworkers see their cases. Supervisors reassign follow-ups. A partner sees only a specifically authorized referral summary.

Build prompt

Build “Case Note & Referral Tracker” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Capture consent scope, referral date, assigned worker, next contact and partner response. Keep internal case notes separate from the shared referral. Assigned caseworkers see their cases. Supervisors reassign follow-ups. A partner sees only a specifically authorized referral summary. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

With consent for a housing referral, a worker sends the approved summary. The partner can accept it and cannot read internal notes. The worker sees the follow-up move to accepted.
